group_position: first shot of grp009 — Alice on her map start (shaft_centre); the map gives her no path, so she holds the open middle for the whole group. This is the sh001 set-up recognised.

characters.label: Alice
characters.start_pos: mid-air at the open centre of the shaft, the bookshelf wall on her screen-right
characters.space_fragment_en: standing upright in mid-air at the open centre of the shaft, held high in frame, facing the bookshelves on screen-right

beats.action: settles back into the fall as if into an armchair
ankles cross, hands come to her lap

performance.objective: keep herself company by talking about something ordinary
performance.goal: keep herself company by talking about something ordinary
performance.emotional_arc: from comfortable self-possession to the first small pull of homesickness she does not name
